propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Concede, quaesumus, omnipotens Deus: ut fideles tui, qui sub sanctissimae
Virginis Mariae Nomine et protectione laetantur; ejus pia intercessione, a
cunctis malis liberentur in terris, et ad gaudia aeterna pervenire mereantur
in caelis. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Tua, Domine, propitiatione, et beatae Mariae semper Virginis intercessione,
ad perpetuam atque praesentem haec oblatio nobis proficiat prosperitatem et
pacem. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et
regnat in unitate.

translations.caution:
A pre-1955 lay hand missal, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its rubrics, its seasonal second and third orations, its Holy Week and its sanctoral are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.
